newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to examine jobs decree law on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to examine jobs decree law on Friday.

text.p: Italy's cabinet will meet on Friday to examine a decree law concerning a package of measures to help ease unemployment, said a statement from the prime minister's office on Thursday.
The decree law is aimed at speeding up investments to create new jobs in a package put together by labour minister Tiziano Treu.

Italy's upper house Senate approved the jobs package late Wednesday after the centre-left government overcame strains with its hard-left Communist Refoundation allies on how to create The Treu bill includes provisions aimed at cutting the working week, introducing more flexible work contracts and boosting apprenticeship schemes.
